Original (internal): Upstream regression tests are .dox files executed by
testing/runtests.py, which runs the compiled binary and diffs generated XML
vs reference XML.

Upward trace (CLI reachability):
  runtests.py -> ./executable <generated Doxyfile>

Downward trace (observability):
  ./executable writes XML to <outputdir>/test_output_<id>/out/*.xml;
  runtests.py diffs vs testing/<id>/*.xml and reports ok/not ok.

External behavioral test:
  Run the compiled binary through runtests.py for this id; expect exit code 0.

Note: test 012 requires an external 'bibtex' binary which is not present in
this environment, so it is skipped.

CATCHES: implementations that break on description terms with newlines, producing
malformed LaTeX \item commands or losing term content.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to add id attributes to paragraph elements,
which are used for precise navigation and reference linking.

Golden files: None (structural validation)

CATCHES: implementations where --no-fancy flag doesn't disable progress
bars, fancy UI elements, or emoji, or where it doesn't switch to plain
INFO/ERROR logging format.
Test LaTeX standalone output.

CATCHES: implementations that accept array values for string options, treating
[foo, bar] as valid for a string option, instead of properly validating type and
rejecting arrays with a clear error pointing to the YAML Array type.
Build with logo.
Build with empty README.
Test build with very long version string.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to parse or display the published_at or
created_at timestamp from GitHub releases, show malformed dates, or use wrong
timezone conversion in the rendered date string.

Uses DEBUG_DATA_CLAMP_DATE to ensure deterministic results and avoid rate limiting.

CATCHES: --site-path flag ignored, or not included in generated CI's
'cd' command before running oranda build.

Golden files: ci_with_site_path.golden -- site_path='my-site'

CATCHES: implementations that produce invalid JSON when --time and --json
are combined, or fail to include duration field in JSON output — tests
output.rs timing and JSON integration.
CATCHES: implementations that don't accept lowercase 'hs' class.
Multiple queries using explicit flags.

CATCHES: implementations that misparse 0x0 or treat it as invalid, even though
it's a valid hex representation of zero, or that have special-case bugs where
hex zero is treated differently from decimal zero.
Test queries with multiple nameservers
Test compilation with unicode in filename.

CATCHES: implementations that reject Feb 28 in non-leap years, confuse leap year
rules, or fail to correctly determine maximum day in February for non-leap years.

CATCHES: implementations where #cite() function doesn't work while @key 
syntax does, or where the two syntaxes produce different output when they 
should be equivalent.

Input files:
    simple.bib -- BibTeX file

CATCHES: implementations that don't detect unclosed delimiters, report wrong
line/column numbers, hang on parsing errors, or use different error formatting.
The exact error format matters for IDE integrations.

Golden files: unclosed_delim.stderr.golden -- compile unclosed_delim.typ stderr

CATCHES: implementations that reject comparing pure ratio with relative
that has only relative component, fail to normalize, or use wrong comparison.
Test all basic SGR codes (0-9).

CATCHES: implementations that fail on realistic file paths, don't handle
forward slashes correctly in filter queries, break on multi-level paths, or
display wrong results when filtering source code file lists.

Golden files:
    state_filter_filter.golden -- screen after typing "filter" on code_files.txt
Test with TSV-like input.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to parse hex color strings like #ff00ff,
don't set the AttrTrueColor flag when processing hex colors, or fail to apply
RGB values to foreground attributes — must load config successfully and render
with the hex color applied to the Matched style element.

Golden files:
    state_hex_fg.golden -- screen with #ff00ff foreground on Matched
Input files:
    config_hex_fg.json -- Style.Matched: ["#ff00ff"]
    items_5.txt -- 5 fruit names
Test different filter types with queries.
Each subcommand should respond to -h.
Test headers command with multiple files.

CATCHES: implementations that fail to correctly count rows in files with 
1000+ rows and 50+ columns, potentially due to buffer overflow, incorrect 
line parsing, or premature EOF detection.
Test count with both delimiter and no-headers flags.

CATCHES: implementations where random sampling fails on large datasets (10000 rows) -
incorrect reservoir sampling logic, duplicate rows in sample, or wrong sample size.
Uses --seed for deterministic testing.

CATCHES: implementations that don't read patterns from file when -f is
specified, treat newlines in the pattern file as part of the pattern instead
of separators, or don't handle empty lines correctly.

CATCHES: implementations that impose arbitrary pattern length limits, buffer
overflow on long patterns, or crash when patterns exceed expected size — these
would either reject the pattern, truncate it silently, or crash.
Test searching from stdin.
Test -L/--files-without-match flag.

CATCHES: implementations that don't support -T (negate type) or that
incorrectly include the negated type in results rather than excluding it.

Golden files: negate_type_rust.golden -- ./executable -T rust "pattern"

CATCHES: Invalid --top value not rejected, incorrect error message for out-of-range top

CATCHES: implementations that fail when input and output layouts are identical,
trigger emulation unnecessarily when both are the same, or produce incorrect key
mappings — same layout on both sides must work correctly (no translation needed).
